summary: Phase-2 production history verified through public APIs and browser. Backend 19/19 passed. Intro, configured Grafana link/new tab, replace redirect, all five ranges, localStorage, all legends, both battery plots and W/% tooltips, 19 deltas, distributions, grouped daily values and final sun timeline passed. Fresh desktop/mobile views have no content overflow or runtime exceptions. One hover-then-resize overflow edge case reproduced. Prior balance error/retry and unavailable-yesterday bugs pass retesting.

ui_bugs.issue: After hovering a daily bar at 1920px, scrolling to the sun timeline, and resizing to 390px, document scrollWidth becomes 628px. An inactive/empty recharts-tooltip-wrapper retains its desktop position (right edge 627.75px), causing horizontal page overflow. Fresh mobile load and both views otherwise measure exactly 390px.

action_items: Constrain/reset the inactive daily-chart tooltip after viewport resize so it cannot enlarge the mobile document; replay check_hover_resize_overflow.
Optionally suppress initial Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) measurement warnings; charts subsequently render correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: BalanceHistoryBars leaves tooltip positioning to Recharts without containing its overflow; retained desktop tooltip coordinates cause the reproduced mobile edge case.

History.jsx silently catches config/live/today/history failures. History failure displays an empty-history message rather than an explicit fetch error; this is a code-review observation, not a real public API outage observed in this run.

success_rate.frontend: All requested core flows passed; hover-resize overflow supplemental regression failed

seed_data_creation: None; no database writes. Existing hardware remains DEMO/MOCKED. Supplemental 503/yesterday-failure checks used temporary MOCKED network responses. Grafana destination document was MOCKED only to verify tab creation because configured private-LAN URL is not reachable from this preview browser; actual Grafana service availability not verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No application source changed. Existing preview regression adapted to phase-2 redirect and removed back button; aggregate saved run entry was not separately executed, while equivalent checks and hover-resize regression were executed inline via browser automation. First Grafana popup wait timed out on private LAN navigation; context route interception then proved a new tab opens with the exact configured URL. Initial viewport assertion failed after tooltip hover; clean diagnostic run passed all four size/view combinations, then full hover-resize reproduction confirmed 628px scroll width. Browser emitted repeated Recharts initial dimension warnings but zero pageerror events. Previous iteration-30 balance error bug is fixed, including retry; missing yesterday yields all 19 unavailable comparisons.
rca of the issue: Reproduce: load /verlauf desktop 1920x800, choose four channels, hover first nonzero daily PV bar, scroll to sun timeline, switch bogen then balken, resize to 390x844, click four channels. Empty hidden Recharts daily tooltip remains translated to desktop x coordinate, outside mobile viewport; document width 628 versus 390. Main non-tooltip content remains contained. Constrain tooltip overflow or reset position on responsive size change; do not treat this as chart data failure.
